issues.description: ValidationReport.add(level, stage, message) files an entry under errors/skipped/success only when level is one of those words; anything else lands in warnings. Fixed in three passes: 56efb2cb04a02b9efa7f336d09af499c256f04ac corrected 26 reversed-order call sites in pipeline_stages/ (stages 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 12); 7df27c8001a5d5c5f2f0b45e094bb9e5489086e0 corrected the 20 remaining package-wide sites (main_pipeline.py 11, quality/quality_gates.py 4, quality/quality_gate_manager.py 5) and widened the regression guard from pipeline_stages/ only to all of ultimate_pipeline/; a6d1039695cf660428d69dcdde4979d0f0477b23 updated two stale test fixtures in tests/unit/test_semantic_overlap_wiring.py that still asserted the old (stage, key, payload) argument order after 7df27c80.

issues.description: Residual closure of GAP-067: the original fix (0b96a4f55a31cefb6b6ff9abc32263b1a99f1beb; 72ce77902f4f552c049cbfa2bc81b02721e3d2bf) made the offline carla stub install only when the real client is not importable, but left a carla-less environment getting the stub via a plain pytest.importorskip("carla") -- importorskip only skips when the import fails, and once the stub is installed into sys.modules the import succeeds, so tests meaningful only against the genuine live-client API (test_carla_classes.py::test_constant_matches_live_carla_enum_when_available, test_semantic_tagging.py::test_city_object_labels_match_real_carla_enum, and the GAP-021 Osm2Odr conversion module) ran against stub attributes and failed instead of skipping. 6885dfc2ad4950f3267d23b9578efc10dc83a500 closes this: both stub modules are marked __offline_stub__ = True, and a new tests/unit/_carla_real.py::require_real_carla() behaves like importorskip but additionally skips when the imported module is the offline stub; the three affected call sites now use it.
issues.fixing_commit: 6885dfc2ad4950f3267d23b9578efc10dc83a500 (residual: tests/unit/_carla_real.py require_real_carla() + __offline_stub__ markers; real-client tests skip instead of failing against the stub)

issues.subsystem: map geometry (junction connector exits) -- real 07_lanes map
issues.description: Root cause reproduced (46708baa6dc69b299dbb04c6c9ee775ea9bd04fe): the default-on junction connector snap (ultimate_pipeline/tools/junction_connector_snap.py _set_geometry_pose, called from ultimate_pipeline/pipeline_stages/stage_05_geometry.py; UP_ENABLE_JUNCTION_CONNECTOR_SNAP default "1", on since 2026-09-12) sets a connector's start pose (x, y and hdg) to the incoming road's end pose but keeps its paramPoly3/arc curve coefficients, rotating the connector so its far end no longer meets the exit road. Reproduced in memory on 05_planview (sha256 45c52059ec5b7d8d1e5f2f90a2f814bde465a923e7e77768c5f5e660790c721c, read-only, nothing written): heading kinks >30 deg 351 -> 3,720; ~53 deg bucket 4 -> 3,373; connectors_snapped = 4,025 (matches the run's own snap report and the 4,025 connectors whose planView changed between 05 and 06). Evidence: reports/production_readiness/20261103T000000Z_GAP070_STAGE_BISECTION/ROOT_CAUSE_JUNCTION_CONNECTOR_SNAP.md (46708baa6dc69b299dbb04c6c9ee775ea9bd04fe); confirmed these exact figures appear verbatim in that file on re-read 2026-11-04. A remediation candidate exists but is NOT merged, on branch fix/gap070-connector-snap-exit-20261103: a Hermite refit that re-fits the connector curve to both the incoming end pose and the declared exit anchor, failing closed (skipped_missing_exit_anchor) when no exit anchor is declared, measured in 03aaccd4baf7d3c11a5cb4b3896aa7644204f8ce's normalized receipt (same measurement.json content as the implementation commits ffbe677e941083950e07d828b5cdab82fd67f17a and f765dcb2669a1544e3310c4d229b95baba508f68 on that branch) on 05_planview: entry start mismatches 4,092 -> 67; entry end mismatches 4,043 -> 560; exit heading kinks 351 -> 349; ~53 deg bucket 4 -> 4; geometry gaps 0; 4,025 refits; 0 residuals -- confirmed by reading the diff of 03aaccd4, which shows exactly these before/after numbers in measurement.json. Tests for the candidate are in 2cee039f235f2cff7c87fa1fce935154cdcf3cd8 (tests/unit/test_junction_connector_classifier.py, no product code changed in that commit).
